Step of the Panther
Instant40 sec cooldown
Invokes Bethekk
You transform into a Panther, increasing your movement speed by 30% for 6 sec and clearing any root effects and making you immune to root effects.

For the first 3 sec of this effect, you cannot be hit by any attacks or spells, but causing any direct damage or healing will end the effect.
